account_ids.description:
Accounts this key may act on. `null` means every account the owner can
access; otherwise the key is restricted to exactly these accounts.

ApiKeyPermissions.description:
Per-key permission flags, scoping what an API key may do on the accounts it
targets. Mirrors the granular account permissions: the effective authority on
a request is these flags intersected with the user's current permissions on
the requested account, so a key can never out-rank its owner.

AuthenticateRequest.description: Exchange an API key and secret for a bearer token.

ask_close.description: Best ask price at the end of the interval

ask_high.description: Highest best ask price during the interval

ask_low.description: Lowest best ask price during the interval

ask_open.description: Best ask price at the start of the interval

bid_close.description: Best bid price at the end of the interval

bid_high.description: Highest best bid price during the interval

bid_low.description: Lowest best bid price during the interval

bid_open.description: Best bid price at the start of the interval

mid_close.description: Mid-price at the end of the interval

mid_open.description: Mid-price ((bid + ask) / 2) at the start of the interval

ts.description: Start timestamp of the candle interval (epoch seconds)

ClerkLoginRequest.description: Log in with a Clerk session token, exchanging it for an AX session token.

clerk_token.description: Session JWT obtained from Clerk after completing sign-in.

account_ids.description:
Accounts the key may act on. Each must be one the caller has access to.
When omitted, the key covers every account the caller can access. When
provided, the key is restricted to exactly those accounts.

oneOf.description:
Permissions to grant the key, intersected per request with the caller's
current permissions on the requested account (so a key can never
out-rank its owner). When omitted, the key is granted full permissions
and behaves as the user.

CursorPage.description:
Page metadata for cursor-paged responses.

This is intended for response bodies (not query params).

CursorPagination.description:
Cursor-based paging.

Pass `cursor` from a previous response to get the next page. Set `limit` to control
page size (accepts number or string).

DaysOfWeek.description:
Days of week using ISO 8601 numbering (1=Monday, 7=Sunday).

This type ensures that all day values are in the valid range [1, 7].
It is serialized as a JSON array of numbers for API compatibility.

is_block_trade.description:
True if this fill was generated by a block trade — a privately
negotiated trade booked away from the order book.

is_final_settlement.description:
True if this fill was generated by final settlement of a delisted or
expired contract at the final settlement price; the counterparty is the
exchange settlement account. Implies `is_block_trade`.

date.description: The date this exception applies to

FundingRateSchedule.description: Machine-readable funding rate schedule for perpetual contracts

exceptions.description:
Dates with modified schedules (e.g., half-days, special times, or holidays).

Note: Exception dates are interpreted in the schedule's timezone (the benchmark timezone),
not UTC. For example, if the timezone is "America/New_York" and an exception date is
"2025-12-25", it refers to December 25th in New York time.

timezone.description: Timezone for all times (chrono_tz::Tz, serializes as IANA string)

FundingSlot.description: One funding slot of a trading day.

capped.description: True when the rate was clamped by the symbol's funding rate cap.

funding_rate_bps.description:
The slot's funding rate in basis points; positive means longs pay
shorts.

premium_bps.description: Premium of the mark TWAP over the underlying TWAP, in basis points.

reason.description: Why the slot was skipped; present only on skipped slots.

FundingTransaction.description:
A cash leg booked against a position-bearing account by a settlement
event. Covers perpetual funding-rate payments, daily mark-to-market on
any position-bearing contract, and the one-time final settlement at a
dated contract's expiration — discriminated by `transaction_type`.

`funding_rate`, `funding_amount`, and `benchmark_price` are populated
only for `Funding` and absent for the other kinds. `settlement_price`
and `amount` apply to every kind.

funding_amount.description:
Per-contract funding cash for this event — same for every user on
the same `(symbol, timestamp)`. Multiply by signed position to
reconstruct the per-user `amount`. (`amount` is the actual cash
booked to *this* account; `funding_amount` is the per-contract
quantity that drove the calculation.)

FundingVariant.description: How a symbol's funding accrues over a trading day.

GetEstimatedFundingRateResponse.description:
Live estimated funding rate for a symbol, served verbatim from the cached
estimate the settlement runner publishes.

GetFundingSlotsResponse.description:
A full trading day of funding slots — realized, projected, skipped, and
pending — with running totals. One surface for both funding variants:
`daily_close` symbols report a single slot.

cap_bps.description: Per-slot cap on the funding rate in basis points, if configured.

interval_count.description:
Number of funding slots scheduled on `date`; 0 on holidays and
weekends.

projected_eod_bps.description:
Projected end-of-day total in basis points: realized so far plus the
projection for the remaining slots.

realized_sum_bps.description: Sum of realized slot rates so far, in basis points.

timezone.description: IANA name of the funding schedule's timezone.

transaction_types.description:
Transaction types to include, as a single comma-separated value
(`transaction_types=deposit,withdrawal`). Repeating the parameter is
rejected; an empty value includes every type. Values not listed here
match nothing rather than erroring.

special_settlements.description: Upcoming special settlements, ordered by settlement time.

estimated_funding_supported.description:
Whether a live index feed is configured for this instrument, so an
intraday funding-rate estimate can be produced. When `false`, the
estimated-funding endpoint reports the symbol as unsupported and
clients should not surface an estimate for it.

expiration.description:
Absolute expiration time for dated contracts. `None` for perpetuals.
Presence of a value is the discriminator between dated and perpetual contracts.

product.description:
Umbrella product this instrument belongs to (e.g. `XAU` for `XAU-PERP`,
`XAU-2026-SEP`, `XAU-2026-DEC`). Instruments that share a `product` are the
same underlying and can be grouped together in a product list.

LimitOffsetPage.description:
Page metadata for limit/offset paged responses.

This is intended for response bodies (not query params).

account_id.description: Optional account ID. If omitted, default (primary) user account is used.
Optional account ID. If omitted, default (primary) user account is used.

SettlementKind.description:
Discriminator for `FundingTransaction`. All variants are a cash leg
booked at a settlement price against a position; only the trigger
differs.

SortDirection.description:
Sort order/direction.

- `asc`: ascending order per field type (e.g. lexicographic, numeric, etc.)
- `desc`: descending order per field type

oneOf.description: Live estimated funding rate, when available for this symbol.

lst.description: Last settlement time as epoch seconds

pl.description: Price band lower limit in USD: the absolute lower bound of the price band that orders are checked against

pu.description: Price band upper limit in USD: the absolute upper bound of the price band that orders are checked against

v.description: Total 24h volume in contracts (quantity traded, not notional value)

Ticker.description: Low frequency (e.g. ~1s or ~5s) stats update for a symbol.

TimeRangeNs.description:
Time range params for API endpoints.

Both fields are optional nanosecond timestamps (UNIX epoch):
- `start_timestamp_ns`: inclusive lower bound
- `end_timestamp_ns`: exclusive upper bound

Leave either field unset to query from the start (-∞) or through the end (+∞).

TimeseriesPagination.description:
Query timeseries data with time range, sort, and paging.

Combines time filtering, sort direction, and cursor paging. Set time bounds and
control result order.

Token.description: Strong type for Token with validation

TradingHoursSegment.description: A single trading hours segment with specific days, times, and state

duration_seconds.description: Duration of this segment in seconds

expire_all_orders.description: Whether to expire all orders during this segment

hide_market_data.description: Whether to hide market data during this segment

time_of_day.description: Time of day when this segment starts

TradingSchedule.description: Trading schedule for an instrument, containing multiple trading hour segments

initiated_by_user_id.description:
Actor of record — the user who initiated the transaction. Present only
for directly-initiated kinds (`deposit`, `withdrawal`); `None` for
order-derived and system-generated transactions.

TransactionType.description: Kinds of ledger entry that can appear as a `Transaction::transaction_type`.

UpcomingSpecialSettlement.description:
Public, user-facing view of an upcoming special settlement. Deliberately
omits internal/operational fields (notes, retry bookkeeping).

long_holder_extra_funding_amount.description:
Per-contract amount credited to long holders (and debited from short
holders) when the settlement executes. Always non-negative.

settlement_ts.description:
Time at which the settlement will be applied. Positions held in the
symbol at this instant determine who is credited or debited.

name.description: Optional, owner-facing nickname for the account.
